verdict.rationale: The pricing page evidence covers only feature listings and a 14-day free trial. The one community mention of price describes a flat $1200/month next tier, not per-search, per-record or per-node rates. Nothing in the pack shows published per-unit pricing that would let a founder predict search costs, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a founder, published per-unit pricing (searches, records, or nodes) lets me predict what search will cost before committing
